description: Categorized Sound Assets and 5-tier Intensity Variations for Beatmaker Studio

intensityLevels.label: Low
intensityLevels.description: Soft, subtle beat with lower intensity

intensityLevels.label: Medium-Low
intensityLevels.description: Slightly stronger sound with warm character

intensityLevels.label: Medium
intensityLevels.description: Balanced default intensity and natural timbre

intensityLevels.label: Medium-High
intensityLevels.description: Stronger and more prominent beat with crisp bite

intensityLevels.label: High
intensityLevels.description: Maximum intended intensity with fuller, saturated punch

kick-classic.name: Kick Classic
kick-classic.description: Versatile punchy kick drum with tight attack and warm sub body.

kick-808.name: Kick 808
kick-808.description: Extended low-end TR-808 bass drum with prolonged pitch sweep.

kick-heavy.name: Kick Heavy
kick-heavy.description: Dense, aggressive transient kick designed for heavy mixes.

kick-softy.name: Kick Softy
kick-softy.description: Gentle, warm, rounded kick drum perfect for lo-fi beats.

kick-punchy.name: Kick Electronic Punch
kick-punchy.description: Tight modern studio kick with crisp click attack and controlled low end (CC0 Stargate Pack).

kick-sub.name: Kick Sub Bass
kick-sub.description: Heavy sustained sub-bass tail ideal for Trap, Drill, and half-time drops (CC0 Fugue State Audio).

kick-analog909.name: Kick Analog 909
